# VidhiCorp Legal Chambers

> VidhiCorp Legal Chambers is a corporate, commercial and dispute resolution law firm based in Gurugram, Haryana, India, led by Founder & Managing Partner Jankee Ballabh Pandey and Co-Founder & Partner Sanjulata Pandey. The chambers advises Indian and international businesses across thirteen practice areas, from preventive corporate advisory through to litigation and arbitration, under the philosophy "Prevent. Protect. Resolve. Grow."

Key facts:
- Founder & Managing Partner: Jankee Ballabh Pandey — 20+ years across in-house counsel roles (most recently Head of Legal & Integrity Officer, Atotech; earlier at Unilever, Whirlpool, Trident) and courtroom practice before the District Court, Central Administrative Tribunal, Delhi High Court and Supreme Court of India. Awards: Best Leading Lawyers 2022, Top 10 General Counsel 2022.
- Co-Founder & Partner: Sanjulata Pandey.
- Registered office: I-001, Maple Crescent, C-Block, Sushant Lok 1, Sector 43, Gurugram, Haryana 122009, India.
- Phone: +91 98102 01992 / +91 99535 11555. Email: info@vidhicorplegal.com.
- Track record: 2,000+ domestic and international commercial contracts and transactions; 800+ litigation, M&A, compliance and employment matters; ₹1,200+ Crore in disputes and arbitration handled; USD 600 million in cross-border dispute support, across Asia-Pacific, Europe and North America.
- The chambers does not solicit work or advertise, in accordance with the Rules of the Bar Council of India; this site and this file are informational only and do not constitute legal advice or an invitation to engage the firm.

## Practice areas
Thirteen practice areas: Corporate & Commercial Advisory, Transactions & Strategic Advisory, Contracts & Agreements, Joint Ventures, Mergers & Acquisitions, Cross-Border Transactions, Funding & Investments, Employment/HR & POSH, Compliance & Regulatory Support, Dispute Resolution & Arbitration, Due Diligence, Intellectual Property Rights, and Legal Opinions.
- [Practice Areas](https://www.vidhicorplegal.com/practice-areas.html): full detail on all thirteen areas and their sub-services.

## Insights (practical legal writing, India-focused)
- [Trademark renewal in India](https://www.vidhicorplegal.com/insights/trademark-renewal-timelines.html): TM-R filing deadlines and restoration windows under the Trade Marks Act, 1999.
- [Reading the indemnity clause](https://www.vidhicorplegal.com/insights/reading-the-indemnity-clause.html): how counterparties actually scrutinise indemnity clauses in Indian commercial contracts.
- [Corporate compliance calendar for India](https://www.vidhicorplegal.com/insights/compliance-calendar-for-growing-entities.html): deadline-based vs event-based compliance for growing Indian companies.
- [Arbitration vs litigation in India](https://www.vidhicorplegal.com/insights/arbitration-vs-litigation-timing.html): when arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 is genuinely faster than court, and when it isn't.
- [POSH compliance checklist for India](https://www.vidhicorplegal.com/insights/posh-compliance-beyond-the-policy.html): Internal Committee composition, timelines and common compliance gaps under the POSH Act, 2013.
- [ESOP pool sizing for Indian startups](https://www.vidhicorplegal.com/insights/esop-pool-sizing-for-startups.html): structuring employee stock option pools under the Companies Act, 2013.
